nodes.title: INTER-KF INTERVAL 01 PROMPT - START TO MID
widgets_values: Mara stands at the base of the lighthouse wearing her navy coat. She looks up at the darkened lamp above the harbor. Mara begins walking towards the lamp post, taking slow steps in the wet grass. Her weight shifts from one foot to the other as she moves forward. The wind blows across the windows of the lighthouse, causing rainwater to move down the glass. Mara's gaze remains fixed on the lamp as she approaches it.

nodes.title: INTER-KF INTERVAL 02 PROMPT - MID TO END
widgets_values: Mara reaches the lantern room and removes the cracked glass panel from the frame. She cleans the wet metal with her hands, then carefully installs the replacement panel. As the clouds separate, Mara restarts the warm lamp beam sweeping across the quiet harbor.
